blocks.text: Clinical trials (insanon par dawa ya ilaaj ke tajarbe) aur medical research mein biostatistics bohat ahem hai. Yeh studies design karne aur data ka analysis karne ka dhaancha (framework) deti hai, taa ke nataij durust aur bharosemand hon. Statistical tareeqon se biostatisticians nayi dawaon, ilaaj aur medical aalaat (devices) ki hifazat (safety) aur asar (effectiveness) jaanchte hain. Is se doctors saboot ki bunyad par (evidence-based) faisle karte hain jo mareezon ki dekh bhaal behtar karte aur medical ilm barhate hain.
